body:
> From the 2026-08-28 Agent SDK evaluation, step 3a — split out because it is small, independent, and two triage cards want it.

## Why

`claude -p --output-format json` on 2.1.251 already signs off with `terminal_reason`, `api_error_status`, `modelUsage` (per-model tokens) and `permission_denials`, alongside the `session_id`/`total_cost_usd`/`num_turns`/`duration_ms` hkb keeps. `parseSessionLog` (`src/model.js:465-480`) truncates the result to `SESSION_FIELDS` and throws the rest away — and then `watchChild` (`src/dispatch.js:838-850`) grep-scans the log tail for `429|rate limit|quota|401|unauthorized` to guess why the worker died, which the result already states.

Two open cards are waiting on exactly these fields: #130 (the denied-tools ledger — `permission_denials` is one of its three shapes, delivered for free on process-mode attempts) and #116 (`terminal_reason` tells "hit `--max-turns` with a PR open" from "crashed").

## What

- Extend `SESSION_FIELDS` / `parseSessionLog` with `terminal_reason`, `api_error_status`, `model_usage`, `permission_denials`. Unknown fields stay ignored; old logs still parse.
- `watchChild`: pause the profile on `api_error_status` 401/429 from the result; keep the regex only as the fallback for a log with no JSON line.
- `hkb show <n>` prints `ended: <terminal_reason>` and `denied: <tool> ×N` when present; `--json` carries them on the attempt row verbatim.
- The tick reads the log tail for pid-mode rows it writes off as `crashed`/`timed_out`, so they get session and cost the way `--bg` rows do since #137.
- Pin the field names in a test against a fixture from `claude --version` 2.1.251, so a rename upstream fails a test rather than silently emptying the row.

## Done when

- An attempt that ended on `--max-turns` shows `terminal_reason` in `hkb show` and `--json`.
- A 429 in the result pauses the profile without the log regex.
- `node --test test/model.test.js test/dispatch.test.js` covers the new fields and an old-format log.
title: Read the whole --output-format json result: terminal_reason, api_error_status, model_usage, permission_denials on the attempt row
